text:
rene: Heads-up 1  I'm trying to finalize the Usage page layout for the next release. Two competing chart ideas: a heatmap by project (density view) vs a timeline sparkline (trend view). Where should invoice actions live in each?
kai: Link to quick mocks: https://www.figma.com/file/HEATMAP_VS_TIMELINE

Option H (heatmap): dense grid with project rows + color intensity for spend buckets. Pros: fast scanning of outliers. Con: hard to fit per-row actions without crowding.
Option T (timeline): wide chart per project with sparkline and token/USD numbers. Pros: clearer trends, room for per-row affordances.
pm_liu: Finance/legal: primary requirement is discoverable official invoice download. Prefer top-level CTA for Org scope but ok with per-project exports for Project scope.
abby: UX: heatmap is great for anomaly detection but users also want quick export. If we add per-row icons in heatmap it'll be visually noisy. Maybe a header CTA + a row-level kebab that expands to 'Download invoice / Export CSV' — keeps UI tidy.
sam: Engineering: heatmap will render many cells; per-row kebab is fine but each kebab needs invoice metadata. We should avoid N API calls for metadata on page load. Lazy-load metadata on kebab open or viewport intersection.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: heatmaps must not rely on color alone. Include numeric labels on hover/focus and a table alternative for screen readers. Download actions need accessible names, e.g., 'Download invoice for Project X'.
rene: Proposal: Use hybrid pattern: default view is Timeline for new users (better readability). Add a toggle to switch to Heatmap for power users. Keep a persistent header-level CTA labeled 'Download invoice' when Org scope selected; when Project scope is selected show a kebab menu per row with 'Download invoice' and 'Export CSV' options. Kebab opens lazy-loading invoice metadata.
kai: Responsive concerns: on mobile collapse timeline into stacked cards and show the header CTA as sticky bottom action. Heatmap becomes a condensed list with a button 'Open heatmap' to a full-screen view.
pm_liu: Copy: confirm we use 'Download invoice' for official PDF and 'Export CSV' for CSV. Legal ok with that phrasing.
abby: Also want a small token denomination toggle near the chart: 'Tokens / USD' so customers can prefer either metric. Make sure it persists per user (localStorage) and is keyboard accessible.
sam: Estimates: frontend 3d to add view toggle + header CTA + kebab lazy-load flow; backend 1d to add batch invoice metadata endpoint. Will open tickets.
infra-bot: infra-bot: created ticket INF-1203 for invoice metadata batch endpoint.
rene: Action items: kai update figma with timeline default + heatmap toggle + token-denom toggle; abby to write microcopy and responsive behavior; a11y-bot to add SR table alternative and aria acceptance criteria; sam link backend ticket. I'll mark ready-for-dev once figma + tickets are linked. Thanks all! :rocket:
